contract.self_mutation_isolation: A listener can remove itself during callback execution without aborting EventBus.emit()
contract.current_cycle_self_remove_continuity: A listener removing itself during an active broadcast still receives that broadcast exactly once
contract.post_remove_isolation: A self-removed listener receives no subsequent broadcasts
contract.remaining_listener_continuity: Other registered listeners continue receiving broadcasts after self-removal
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after callback-driven self-removal
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Self-removal does not create duplicate or stale owner entries
contract.delivery_once: Each applicable listener receives each broadcast exactly once
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after callback-driven self-removal
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
